method: Local MiniLM embeddings propose one defect family per disjoint batch. Mandatory human review verifies identities, counts, currency and total batch loss. Approved complete ledgers sum counts and total loss, rank descending on the chosen metric and select a prefix reaching the target, including all cutoff ties. Alphabetical baseline selects the same number of nonzero families. Coverage is descriptive, not causal, predicted savings or AI confidence. Zero-metric families remain in groups but not the priority list.
